controls: Local Docker LSB and Hxitest only; fixed full addons and cache; normalized RDM99/BLM49 with prior status effects cleared; noon, clear weather, fixed camera, draw distance 20; each run bounded to 360 seconds.
limitations: These are synthetic stress results, not predictions of typical absolute FPS.
Separate launches can drift; within-run ABBA comparisons are stronger evidence.
Stable summaries trim settled holds; use untrimmed arrival intervals for loading spikes.
Diagnostic ABBA packages can override the static configuration at Present boundaries; the named comparison identifies the actual modes.

Startup without application presents is excluded before parsing; contiguous markers are required from 16 seconds before through 16 seconds after the measured phase.
